# brand in unified light and dark syntax


```{r}
#| lst-label: lst-fibonacci
#| lst-cap: A naive algorithm for computing Fibonacci numbers.
fib <- function(x) {
  if (x < 2) 1 else fib(x - 1) + fib(x - 2)
}
```
